name: Ramco Industries Limited
summary: Ramco Industries Limited engages in the building products, textiles, and power generation businesses in India. The company operates through three segments: Building Products, Textile and Wind Power Generation segments. It offers G.I. channels and ceiling sections, connecting clips, soffit cleat, rawl plug, fibre tape mesh, self-drilling, tapping screws, and jointing compounds; pre-coated wall angle, frame, and level clips; and metal framing and accessories. The company also provides building material for dry walls and ceilings; and fibre cement boards, tiles and planks, roofing products, fiber cement sheets, brick and mortar, and calcium silicate ceiling tile.
